Intro: Excuse me. We've been getting some complaints about the smell of your establishment.
The concern is that your food is unsanitary and shouldn't be served to the public.
Well, no better time for an inspection. Show me a half-decent [DISH], and I'll get out of your hair.
Success: I'll let you go for now, then. But I am curious about what that smell is.
Fail: This definitely cannot be legal to serve. You'd better tighten up your act.
Reject: I was going to let you off the hook with an informal inspection. I guess you'd prefer the works.
